text:
maria: Handoff check — release 2.4.1 is scheduled for TOMORROW 16:00 PT. Please hold merges to main after 15:55 PT. Can we confirm branch quarantine is enforced and that the green-sweep job will run at 15:30?
akash: Quarantine is applied to release/* branches. I'll flip the embargo flag at 15:50 if no blockers.
ryan: I have changelog bump PR #4187 queued, just waiting on one review. Won't merge until after cutoff.
ci-bot: nightly-smoke: success — 04/03 10:00 UTC :white_check_mark:
sara: Quick heads-up — flakies tracking: test_inference_cache sometimes times out. I tagged it flaky in pytest. For the green-sweep let's run `pytest -k "not flaky" -m smoke`.
derek: Queued a rerun for the failing suite and added a temporary skip for the hung test. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1192
olivia: Can SLO owners confirm rollback playbook is ready? We should verify the slow-start canary (10% -> 100% over 30m).
akash: Rollback playbook updated in runbook.md. Step 2 includes `kubectl rollout undo` and consumer traffic switchover. Also added tracing flag for canary.
maria: OK. CI green check at 15:30 will be the go/no-go. If any last-minute flakes, ping me and I'll hold the cut. @derek please post CI link when reruns finish.
ci-bot: pre-release-green-sweep triggered by @akash at 15:30 PT — jobs: build, unit, smoke, e2e (partial).
derek: Rerun done — all passing now except 1 flaky in e2e that repros intermittently. Isolating it; not a release blocker IMO. Link: https://ci.internal/build/7823 :eyes:
ryan: If that flaky spikes in the canary, can we fallback to previous model variant? Inference tests depend on the KV cache shape.
sara: Model-variant fallback ready (v2.3 -> v2.2). Routing policy updated in staging; ops can flip if perf/regressions appear.
maria: Final checklist: (1) embargo on merges after 15:55 PT, (2) green-sweep pass at 15:30, (3) changelog PR merged by 15:45, (4) rollback plan synced. Anyone see issues?
akash: All good from infra.
olivia: SLO and telemetry look stable.
maria: Awesome. I'll post an explicit GO at 16:05 PT if everything stays green. Thanks all :tada:
derek: Tag & release command I'll run after GO:
```
git checkout release/2.4
git tag -a v2.4.1 -m "release 2.4.1"
git push origin v2.4.1
```
